resources.string: Tap the ring, speak as long as you like - recording is unlimited - then shape your voice and preview it.
Your microphone is morphed in real time and played out of this device - speaker or headphones, the same app handles both automatically.
Android hands the microphone to one app at a time. Live morphing runs while Voice Filter is in front; the floating HUD keeps controls and broadcast available on top of your game.

A tiny floating bubble that stays on top of PUBG, Free Fire, COD Mobile and every other app. Blue = male voice, pink = female voice. Drag it anywhere, tap to toggle live monitor, long-press for the quick panel.
Allow "display over other apps" for Voice Filter
HUD active - tap to open Voice Filter

Android gives the microphone exclusively to the game on screen and has no virtual-mic API, so without root no app can inject audio into a game - Voice Filter never injects anything. Instead it broadcasts your filtered clip out loud at max volume and the game microphone picks it up. Clean, safe, ban-proof.
1. Record and filter your line in Studio.\n2. Join voice chat in your game.\n3. Press Broadcast (here or on the HUD) - countdown, then max volume straight into the game mic.
Routes broadcast to the loudspeaker even when a headset is plugged in, so teammates always hear you.
No clips yet. Record and save one in the Studio tab first.
Voice Filter needs microphone access to change your voice.
No root, no injection, no hidden permissions: microphone, overlay and network only. Clips never leave your device unless you share them.
